title: Jungle Ninja - Lomdi aur Laddoo Chor
style: Vibrant 3D animated Pixar-style short, warm festival lighting, expressive cartoon animals with big eyes and exaggerated comedic acting, rich saturated colours, smooth cinematic motion.
world: A cheerful Indian jungle village with mud-and-bamboo huts, marigold garlands, diyas and festival decorations, a big banyan tree in the central square.

bhola.look: a chubby, fluffy black sloth bear with a pale snout and a cream chest patch, small round ears, a red-and-yellow checked gamchha scarf around his neck, always looks hungry and innocent

kallu.look: a glossy black crow with sharp bright eyes, a tiny green turban, one feather sticking up on his head, perched on branches, always smirking and gossiping

lomdi.look: a small orange fox with a white-tipped tail wearing a dark indigo ninja outfit with a red headband and a face mask pulled down around the neck, tiny shuriken pouch on the belt, extremely overconfident

saya.look: a mysterious dark silhouette on a rooftop, only glowing yellow eyes and the outline of a sharp ninja mask visible, mist around its feet
